verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the whole portrait layout into a sliver in the centre of the 320×50 banner. The headline, body copy, CTA and logo are microscopic and unreadable, and most of the canvas is dead cream space. B does rebuild it as a left-to-right banner (dark logo panel, headline block, orange 'Reserve a Case' CTA with 'Ships late June'), but it's badly cramped. The headline, body and legal text are tiny and jammed together, the last line of body copy collides with the legal line, and the long headline competes with the CTA instead of being cut down.
